submission.one_line: SIP registrations wait 1–2 days because ops re-check every form by hand for missing fields
submission.details: In MF operations we receive about 3,000 SIP forms a day. [[KFIN_EMPLOYEE_1]] and two others re-check each one for missing bank or nominee fields before keying. Forms from [[CLIENT_AMC_1]] branches are the worst. NIGO returns go back by courier.
